_comment: P3G.2 (#22) PR-blocking gate baseline. pass_rate is (passed / (passed + failed)) among NON-xfail cases for the category, from a clean `pytest evals/ -m "not integration"` run -- see evals/conftest.py's pytest_sessionfinish hook and evals/runner/gate.py. Regenerate by running the suite and updating a category's pass_rate deliberately (in its own commit, with a reason) whenever an intentional, reviewed change lowers it -- never to silence an unexplained regression.

citation_present._note: #108 (this fix supersedes the #100 note below): app.semantic_support's duplicate-claim judge inconsistency (two claims restating one guideline-backed fact, both citing the IDENTICAL DocumentCitation, judged with two independent -- and sometimes disagreeing -- LLM calls) was fixed by grouping DocumentCitation results by exact evidence identity and judging each identity once. Live re-verification (production LlamaServerClient, evals.runner.pipeline.run_case, no replay): a1c-target-question 7/8 draws verified, lithium-nsaid-question 8/8 draws verified. Both cases' xfail markers were removed and fresh verified recordings committed. pass_rate is 1.0 because CategoryStats.pass_rate is computed over non-xfail cases only (2 passed / 0 failed here) -- honest gate-ON total is now 2/12, up from the previous 0/12 (see docs/MODEL_AND_HARDWARE_SELECTION.md, 'Issue #108 follow-up'). #100's prior note, for history: the committed 5/12 baseline's 5 non-xfail cases (bp-stage2-question, a1c-target-question, dual-antiplatelet-question, hypertension-lifestyle-followup-question, lithium-nsaid-question) each reflected one STABLE, frozen recording from an earlier draw that was never re-checked against a fresh live draw; re-running all 5 live found every one of them failed to reliably reproduce verified at that time (1/42 live draws). bp-stage2-question, dual-antiplatelet-question, and hypertension-lifestyle-followup-question remain xfail today for reasons unrelated to #108 (see docs/MODEL_AND_HARDWARE_SELECTION.md).
